lines.zh: 我在海沟上面慢慢巡游。
lines.en: I cruise slowly above the deep trench.
One tail sweep churns up the water.

lines.zh: 我沿着珊瑚礁的影子游。
lines.en: I swim along the reef's shadow.

lines.zh: 这片水域的鱼都躲开了。
lines.en: Every fish in this water has fled.
I swim against the current, following scent.

lines.zh: 大嘴张开就能兜住整片水。
lines.en: My wide mouth scoops the whole current.
I slide from the shallows into the dark.

lines.zh: 我的鳍擦过沉船的木板。
lines.en: My fin brushes a sunken ship's planks.

lines.zh: 我绕开那片会发光的藻。
lines.en: I swing wide of the glowing kelp.

lines.zh: 沉在底下的骨头我认得。
lines.en: I know the bones sunk below.
I swim slowly, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 水面上有影子，我浮上去。
lines.en: There is a shadow above; I rise.
My belly skims the sandy floor.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼在我前面散开。
lines.en: A school of small fish scatters before me.

lines.zh: 我从海带林里穿过去，不绕。
lines.en: I push straight through the kelp, not around it.

lines.zh: 这一带我巡过三遍，今天再来。
lines.en: I have patrolled this stretch thrice. Today, again.

lines.zh: 拿盾挡住我的牙，我就晕。
lines.en: Block my teeth with a shield and I'll reel.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我发呆。
lines.en: Light on the surface makes me stare.

lines.zh: 我嚼着一块不知谁的骨头。
lines.en: I chew a bone belonging to someone.
Blood in the water, faint and far.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等水流送东西进来。
lines.en: Mouth open, I wait for the current to bring something.

lines.zh: 这片海安静得让我烦躁。
lines.en: This stretch of sea is annoyingly quiet.

lines.zh: 我的鳃一张一合，慢下来。
lines.en: My gills open and close, slowing.

lines.zh: 我在数从身边游过的鱼。
lines.en: I count the fish swimming past.

lines.zh: 沉船里好像有东西在响。
lines.en: Something rattles inside the wreck.
I rub the reef to dull my teeth.
Hunger comes in tides, wave after wave.

lines.zh: 有只海龟从我头顶游过。
lines.en: A turtle swims over my head.
I settle quietly onto the sand.

lines.zh: 这一带的味道我都记住了。
lines.en: I know every scent in this bay.
You have stood in the water too long.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和肉的味道。
lines.en: You smell of iron and meat.

lines.zh: 你的腿在水里显得很细。
lines.en: Your legs look thin underwater.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，不是你的脸。
lines.en: I watch your feet, not your face.
Do you bite, I wonder.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的那个圆东西是什么。
lines.en: What is that round thing at your belt?
You swim slower than I expected.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子落在浅滩。
lines.en: I see your shadow on the shallows.
Stand less straight; I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像能吃的东西。
lines.en: You smell like something I could eat.
A cut has opened between my scales.

lines.zh: 疼，但还没到让我退的地步。
lines.en: It hurts, but not enough to back off.
That hit landed by my gills. Precise.
I lash my tail and thicken the murk.
My blood spreads through the water.

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，也惹火我了。
lines.en: You hurt me, and you angered me.

lines.zh: 我退开一段，重新找角度。
lines.en: I back off and look for an angle.

lines.zh: 我咬空了，牙齿磕到石头。
lines.en: I bit empty water and struck stone.
The blood is mine. It tastes faint.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了你的方向。
lines.en: That blow told me where you stand.
Toss that raw fish over here.

lines.zh: 那块肉，连骨头一起给我。
lines.en: That meat. Bones and all.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的腐肉味了。
lines.en: I smell rotten flesh on you.
Do not fob me off with rotten meat.
That whole fish is one mouthful.
Throw it in the water, not the shore.
Your hand shakes; the fish will drop.
I want it alive; live things struggle.
The smell of blood makes my teeth itch.
A little more; I am not full.
You bumped into my side fin.
I am this big; why squeeze past?

lines.zh: 水面被我们两个搅浑了。
lines.en: We have muddied the water between us.
My scales scraped your leg.
Don't push; turning takes me a while.

lines.zh: 你的船底碰到我的背了。
lines.en: Your boat's hull touched my back.
Move aside; I turn slowly.
This water is too narrow. Nobody move.

lines.zh: 撞一下，你就知道骨头多脆。
lines.en: One bump and you will learn how bones crack.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿游了过去。
lines.en: I swim past, brushing your leg.

lines.zh: 这海里配得上我的没几条。
lines.en: Few in this sea are worth my time.
You swim steadily. I might consider you.

lines.zh: 我们绕着礁石一起转圈。
lines.en: We circle the reef together.
I do not bite my partner.
The deep is quiet, good for spawning.

lines.zh: 你别怕，张嘴不是要吃你。
lines.en: Don't fear; my open mouth is not hunger.
This trench belongs to the two of us.

lines.zh: 我要一条游得快又壮的。
lines.en: I want one fast and thick-bodied.
Follow me. Do not fall behind.

lines.zh: 我们的卵会沉到最深处。
lines.en: Our eggs will sink to the deepest floor.
I swallow this thing whole.
Something in the wreck's chest smells good.
I swim a lap with a bone in my jaws.
Whatever falls in the water is mine.
I hide this meat in a rock crevice.
I bite the fishing line and pull.

lines.zh: 你的鱼竿差点被我拖走。
lines.en: I nearly dragged your fishing rod away.

lines.zh: 我含着东西，说话很含糊。
lines.en: I mumble around the thing in my mouth.
This pearl is too hard to crack.
Too hard to eat. I carry it around.
Something is thrashing in the water.
That squid swims far too slowly.

lines.zh: 血腥味一散开，我的鳍就竖了。
lines.en: The moment blood spreads, my fins rise.
The one on shore has stepped in.
Something small is circling the surface.

lines.zh: 那只海龟的壳不值一提。
lines.en: That turtle's shell means nothing to me.
I pick the biggest one there.
A fish behind me is playing dead.
It swims crooked. I'll take its flank.
This prey will feed me three days.
I sink and come from below.
It still watches the surface. Good.
I fold my fins to shrink my shadow.

lines.zh: 等它游进我够得到的地方。
lines.en: I wait for it to swim into reach.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我就从下面张口。
lines.en: Once the water muddies, I open up from below.
It turned. So did I.
This bite goes for the gills.

lines.zh: 水压在我耳朵里轰轰响。
lines.en: Water pressure roars in my ears.
It has nowhere left to retreat.
Slow now. Do not startle it.
One bite and the bones shatter.
I whip my head and tear it in half.
Blood dyes this water red.
It cannot even manage a cry.
My teeth punch through its shell.
Shattered bone crunches in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这一撞，它的内脏都错了位。
lines.en: That slam knocked its insides loose.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，直到它不动。
lines.en: I hold on until it stops moving.

lines.zh: 它挣扎的力气越来越小。
lines.en: Its struggling grows weaker and weaker.

lines.zh: 剩下的部分我一会再来。
lines.en: I will come back for the rest later.

lines.zh: 我从深水的黑影里浮上来。
lines.en: I rise out of the deep's black shadow.
Seawater slides off my back.
This stretch of sea is mine today.
I open my eyes already hungry.
I stir up a wide cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 深海的冷我早就习惯了。
lines.en: I am used to the deep's cold.

lines.zh: 有船从上面过，我听见了。
lines.en: A boat passed overhead; I heard it.
My shadow is bigger than the reef.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，水都震了一下。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the water shakes.

lines.zh: 这片水域的规矩要重讲。
lines.en: The rules of these waters bear repeating.

lines.zh: 水里的火，烧得我鳞片卷起。
lines.en: Fire underwater curls my scales.

lines.zh: 我被浪冲上礁石，重重砸下。
lines.en: The surf slammed me onto the rocks.
Out of water, my gills stick shut.

lines.zh: 爆开的水把我推出去老远。
lines.en: The blast shoved me a long way.
Something has lodged in my dorsal fin.
This chill freezes outward from my bones.
I crunch every bone in this sea.

lines.zh: 水里一麻，我张嘴都合不上。
lines.en: The water numbs me; my jaw won't close.

lines.zh: 这下面没有水，也没有味道。
lines.en: Down here there is no water, no scent.
